projects.name: Payment Reconciliation and Settlement Pipeline
what_i_did: Raised test coverage of the payment reconciliation module from 45% to 82% using pytest unit and integration tests with Testcontainers, reducing manual finance work from 3 hours to 20 minutes per day.

Built Grafana dashboards and Prometheus alerts to monitor API latency, error rates, and Kafka consumer lag for a settlement pipeline handling approximately 2 million events per day during on-call rotations.
results: Reduced manual finance work from 3 hours to 20 minutes daily
